tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS ARE AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidders should have executed Print and Supply of Answer Booklet similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 80% of the tender quantity mentioned in the tender schedule in any one of the Previous Three Financial Years 2023-24, 2024-25. & 2025-26. However, will be 40% with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises. The Bidder shall submit the information in the Section XV. Even though the Bidder has executed the 80% of the tender quantity (40% with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises), relevant information shall be submitted through Section XV only, otherwise the Bidder shall be categorically rejected without any further enquiry Upload relevant documents mentioned in the Section XV
The Tenderer shall be either proprietorship or partnership firm or a company registered under the companies Act 1956 or a registered society

The Tenderer Should have Printing unit in any states of Karnataka, Kerala, Tamilnadu, Puducherry, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Maharashtra and Goa only along with Factory Registration Certificate and printing unit should be empaneled as Security Printing unit in Indian Banks Association.
Acknowledgment for having submitted the paper samples

Copy of the PAN card of the firm must be uploaded as detailed below.If a firm is sole proprietorship PAN card copy of the proprietorship.If a firm is partnership PAN card copy of the firm only (partners PAN card copy will not be considered). If a firm is private Ltd or Public Ltd.. Company, PAN card copy of the company.
Specified EMD should be credited to CeG account as per IFT Clause (3)
Documents to prove the ownership of Web Offset Machines, online printing machines, CTP Machines, Automatic Cutting Machines and stitching machines
Previous experience in Answer Booklet Printing and in relevant printing in the format mentioned under Section XII
Printing Press unit should have atleast 10,000 Square feet area for work place

The average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should not be less than Rs. 10 Crores during the Financial Years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 (i.e., Assessment Year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 respectively) It will 50% of the Rs. 10 Cores, i.e., Rs. 5 Crores with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises) during the financial years 2022-23 , 2023-24. and 2024-25
Audited balance sheet and Profit and Loss account for the financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 has to be uploaded certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN
Details of Income Tax returns filed for the years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 must be uploaded i.e., assessment Years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 respectively

itemList.itemName: Printing and supply of Answer Booklet containing 10 sheets (All languages and subjects Booklet and Science subject Booklet) and 16 sheets (including 02 graph sheet at the end or mid)- Mathematics subject booklet using A4(210 X 297 MM,), Technical specification as per Section VII (Printing as per the proof Approved by the K.S.E.A.Board)
